texts.preamble: Arivoli Magalir Iyakkam vs The District Collector on 3 June, 2016 Author: M.Venugopal Bench: M.Venugopal Before The Madurai Bench Of Madras High Court Dated: 03.06.2016 Coram The Honourable Mr.Justice M.Venugopal W.P.(MD)No.14714 of 2013 and M.P.(MD).No.1 of 2013 Arivoli Magalir Iyakkam, Rayappanpatti, Uthamapalayam Taluk, Theni District, bearing Regn.No.1.120/97 represented by its President, K.Athilakshmi. ... Petitioner Vs. 1. The District Collector, Theni District. 2. The Joint Registrar of Co-operative Societies, Theni. 3. The District Supply Officer, Theni. 4. The Special Officer, M.D.Thani, 97, Rayappanpatti Primary Agricultural Co-operative Credit Association, Rayappanpatti, Uthamapalayam Taluk, Theni District. ... Respondents Prayer: Writ Petition is filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, to issue a Writ of Mandamus forbearing the respondents 1 and 2 from closing the fair price shop run by the petitioner Iyakkam and handed over the same to the fourth respondent. !For Petitioner : Mr.R.Gowrishankar ^For R1 to R3 : Mr.V.Muruganandam Arivoli Magalir Iyakkam vs The District Collector on 3 June, 2016 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/170811981/ 1 Additional Govt. Pleader For R4 : Mr.J.Gunaseelan Muthiah :O R D E R
texts.facts: The petitioner has focused the instant Writ Petition praying for passing of an order by this Court in directing the respondents 1 and 2 from closing the fair price shop run by it and hand over the same to the fourth respondent. 4. According to the petitioner, its fair price shop is registered in R.C.No.22412232000187 under Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006 and the same is renewed periodically. Further, it is learnt that the fourth respondent/Association had passed a resolution dated 25.06.2013, with the bald allegation that public are facing many troubles by the misconduct of fair price shop run by the Women Association at Rayappanpatti (run by the petitioner) Anaimalayanpatti and Anaipatti. Apart from that, they had decided to obtain permission from the respondent Nos.1 and 2 to retake the said fair price shop for the reasons that now the Sangam is growing and that the said shop would increase their income etc. 5. The grievance of the petitioner is that a detailed representation to the respondents 1 to 3 was submitted, but the respondents had remain silent and not acted till date.
texts.arguments: Hence, the petitioner is constrained to file the present Writ Petition praying for passing of an order by this Court in restraining the respondents 1 and 2 from closing the fair price shop run by the petitioner forum (Iyakkam). 6. The learned Government Advocate appearing for the respondents 1 to 3 fairly submits that the first respondent would consider the representation of the petitioner, dated 26.08.2013, if reasonable time is granted by this Court.
texts.petitioner_arguments: Hence, the petitioner is constrained to file the present Writ Petition praying for passing of an order by this Court in restraining the respondents 1 and 2 from closing the fair price shop run by the petitioner forum (Iyakkam). 6. The learned Government Advocate appearing for the respondents 1 to 3 fairly submits that the first respondent would consider the representation of the petitioner, dated 26.08.2013, if reasonable time is granted by this Court.
